title: Rethinking Cross-Sensor Domain Adaptation for Bridge Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27060v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Segmentation models for bridge point clouds lose accuracy when trained on terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) data and applied to mobile laser scanning (MLS) data. This study re-examines the SemanticBridge TLS-to-MLS protocol to determine how sampling density, surface roughness, color, and acquisition viewpoint are expressed in the 8-cm sparse-voxel representation, and how adaptation gains depend on source-model convergence. Using one sparse-convolution U-Net, we combine raw-point statistics with controlled input perturbations and compare adaptive batch normalization, entropy minimization, Mean Teacher, and confidence-filtered self-training under 100- and 300-epoch schedules. TLS and MLS have similar nearest-neighbor spacing after preprocessing (12.08 and 12.02 mm), and a 4-mm perturbation of TLS points changes voxel occupancy by only 4.4%. translated_title: 重新思考桥梁点云语义分割中的跨传感器域自适应
translated_abstract: 桥梁点云分割模型在使用地面激光扫描（TLS）数据训练后应用于移动激光扫描（MLS）数据时会损失精度。本研究重新审视了SemanticBridge的TLS到MLS协议，以确定采样密度、表面粗糙度、颜色和采集视角在8厘米稀疏体素表示中的表现方式，以及自适应增益如何依赖于源模型的收敛程度。基于一个稀疏卷积U-Net，我们将原始点统计数据与受控输入扰动相结合，并在100个epoch和300个epoch的训练计划下比较了自适应批归一化、熵最小化、Mean Teacher和置信度过滤自训练方法。TLS和MLS在预处理后具有相似的最近邻间距（分别为12.08和12.02毫米），对TLS点施加4毫米扰动仅使体素占据率变化4.4%。颜色分布存在系统性差异，但在相同体素上将颜色置零会使目标测量……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文重新审视桥梁点云语义分割中TLS到MLS的跨传感器域自适应协议，系统分析了采样密度、表面粗糙度、颜色和采集视角在稀疏体素表示中的影响机制，并评估了源模型收敛程度及多种域自适应方法在不同训练周期下的增益效果。
en_tdlr: This paper re-examines the TLS-to-MLS cross-sensor domain adaptation protocol for bridge point cloud semantic segmentation by systematically analyzing how sampling density, surface roughness, color, and acquisition viewpoint are expressed in sparse-voxel representations, and by evaluating how adaptation gains depend on source-model convergence and multiple adaptation methods under different training schedules.
